title: Quantization Gatekeeper: Automated Evaluation Suite for FP8/INT8 Calibration and Accuracy Gates
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated 'Gatekeeper' evaluation suite that validates model accuracy after FP8/INT8 quantization and calibration, using curated golden prompts and pass/fail gates. The harness will run as part of model onboarding, model-variant rollouts, and CI for runtime changes that affect kernel selection or numeric paths.

Background: We have increasing demand to ship quantized model variants (FP8 and INT8) to reduce serving cost. Onboarding currently requires manual spot-checks and ad-hoc calibration runs; this is slow and brittle. ENG-7521 provides a validation harness proof-of-concept; this ticket scopes the production-grade Gatekeeper automation, CI integration, and clear acceptance thresholds for automated rollout gating.

Scope:
- Define golden prompt sets per domain and per model size (conversational, summarization, code, embeddings probe prompts).
- Implement a calibration workflow orchestrator that runs representative calibration data, saves calibration artifacts (scales/zero-points/KV quant maps), and records metadata.
- Compute a deterministic set of accuracy metrics (e.g., BLEU, Rouge-L, embedding cosine, exact match for QA, top-k logits drift, token-level KL) comparing quantized outputs to FP16 baseline.
- Implement pass/fail logic with configurable thresholds and graded severity (block rollout / warn-only).
- Integrate with CI and the model catalog so PRs that change compilation/kernels or introduce new quant profiles trigger the Gatekeeper suite.
- Produce machine-readable results (JSON) and human-readable dashboard links for SRE/Platform/ModelOps.

Non-goals: End-to-end human evaluation, UI for editing golden prompts (initially files in repo + GDrive), training-time quant-aware fine-tuning.

Design notes: Harness will be built as a lightweight runner in Python 3.11 that invokes the runtime in a controlled replay mode (fixed rng, deterministic batching), uses the same KV cache semantics as serving, and exposes a pluggable metric adapter. Results will be stored in the model catalog as artifacts and trigger webhooks to Console rollouts.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Golden prompt suites for 3 canonical domains (chat, summarization, code) exist in the repo and are linked in artifacts.
2) Calibration orchestrator can run FP8 and INT8 pipelines and persist calibration metadata to storage.
3) Automated job runs in CI for PRs touching runtime kernels and returns a structured JSON report within pipeline time budget (<= 40m per shard).
4) Pass/fail gates enforce rollout block on at least two critical metrics for high-impact models; thresholds configurable per-model and per-release.
5) Dashboard links and a lineage entry in the model catalog appear for each run.
6) Example rollback automation (canary -> block -> rollback) is exercised in a staging rollout.
steps: Prepare golden prompt lists and label expected reference outputs
Implement calibration orchestrator with FP8 and INT8 execution paths
Wire up metric adapters (BLEU/ROUGE/cosine/kl/token-drift) and baseline runner
Create pass/fail policy engine with per-model config
Add GitHub Actions job and CI timeout/parallelization strategy
Emit structured JSON artifact and upload to model catalog
Hook results into Console rollout flow and add dashboard panel
